title: The Man in the Chariot
themeTags: the good news is for everyone
reflectionQuestion: The man from far away was filled with joy when he learned about Jesus, and went on his way rejoicing. I wonder what part of God's good news fills your own heart with joy?
kidSafetyNotes: NEW anchor (Early Church, Acts 8). Fills freed ID 1895. Joyful + curious + Scripture-opening. The good-news-is-for-EVERYONE room (a foreigner from far-away Ethiopia is fully welcomed) -- distinct from the lane's raising stories. Beats: God sends Philip to the desert road -> the Ethiopian reads but is puzzled -> 'Do you understand what you are reading?' -> Philip explains it's all about Jesus -> baptism at roadside water -> goes on his way REJOICING. Room = the good news is for every person/land / the joy of understanding / God brings the right helper at the right time. Light, warm, joyful. Soft close ('discover'). VOICE_JAMES_BRITISH_PROFESSIONAL (ear-verified male; warm + clear).

scriptureKeyVerse.text: When they came up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord caught Philip away, and the eunuch didn’t see him any more, for he went on his way rejoicing.
